prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical industrial heritage opening-day poster for OPEN DAY, combining oversized brutal typography, Chinese museum-poster text, architectural cross-section drawing, ink stains, and aged printed-paper texture.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 poster, off-white warm paper background with visible grain, scratches, speckles, faint fold lines, light gray smudges, and subtle letterpress/risograph misregistration. Use a restrained palette of black, charcoal gray, faded beige, rust brown, and thin red-brown annotation lines.

Layout: Dominant typography fills the upper and left side: huge cropped black condensed sans-serif letters reading “OPEN” across the top and “DAY” beneath it, so large that the words are partially cut off by the canvas edges and overlap the architecture. Center the composition on a detailed old factory building elevation/cutaway, occupying most of the lower two-thirds. Place a tall chimney on the right side of the building, rising into the upper area. Keep the right margin for vertical Chinese title text and small annotations. Keep the left margin for a numbered guide list and opening-hour details.

Main subject: A ruined industrial site rendered as a precise architectural ink-and-watercolor section drawing. Show a tall multi-level factory frame with exposed steel trusses, scaffolding, platforms, staircases, old brick and concrete walls, large rectangular windows, arched ground-floor openings, pipes, tanks, small machinery, rail-cart-like objects, and tiny human figures for scale. Add a very tall cylindrical striped smokestack/chimney to the right, weathered and gray. The building should feel like an open industrial relic being preserved and regenerated, with transparent cutaway floors and visible internal structure.

Text content: Include exactly 6 numbered guide entries on the left, each with a large two-digit number and bilingual-style small labels: 01 Main Entrance, 02 Boiler House, 03 Workshop, 04 Machine Shop, 05 Chimney / Water Tower, 06 Viewing Platform. Include small time ranges next to entries, such as 09:30 / 13:30, 10:00 / 14:00, 10:40 / 14:40, 11:20 / 15:20, 12:00 / 16:00, 12:30 / 16:30. Add an opening-hours block reading “OPENING HOURS 09:30 — 17:00” with smaller Chinese text beneath. Add an address block with small Chinese text. On the right side, add large vertical Chinese characters for 开工 开放日 工业遗址, arranged in three stacked columns. Add a small caption reading “过去 / 现场 / 未来” and a short Chinese slogan below it. Add tiny English words near the upper right: “SITE / MEMORY / FUTURE”. Near the lower right add tiny stacked words: “PRESERVE / REGENERATE / SHARE”.

Annotations: Include exactly 3 thin red-brown circular callout graphics labeled 02, 03, and 05 positioned around the building; also include one separate circular date mark near the upper right reading 05 / 18. Add delicate leader lines, small tick marks, microscopic labels, and a few year notes such as 1958, 2012, and 2024.

Visual style: Industrial design poster, architectural blueprint meets ink-wash illustration, archival museum print, worn offset printing, black distressed typography, gridded but asymmetrical Swiss poster composition, subtle rust stains and ink bleeds. The typography should look bold, printed, slightly rough, and physically integrated with the paper. Keep all elements flat and poster-like, not photorealistic.

Constraints: Use exactly one main factory building, exactly one tall chimney, exactly 6 guide-list items, exactly 3 numbered architectural callout circles plus 1 date circle. Avoid bright colors, glossy effects, modern glass architecture, extra logos, QR codes, or watermarks.

promptZh:
目标：为 OPEN DAY 创建一张竖版工业遗址开放日海报，结合超大号粗野主义排版、中文博物馆海报文本、建筑剖面图、墨渍以及陈旧印刷纸张纹理。

画布：3:4 竖版海报，米白色暖色纸张背景，带有可见的纹理、划痕、斑点、淡淡的折痕、浅灰色污迹以及细微的凸版印刷/孔版印刷错位效果。使用克制的色调，包括黑色、炭灰色、褪色的米色、铁锈棕色以及细红棕色的标注线。

布局：主导排版填充上方和左侧：巨大的黑色压缩无衬线字体“OPEN”横跨顶部，“DAY”位于其下方，字号极大，以至于文字部分被画布边缘截断并与建筑重叠。构图中心为详细的老工厂建筑立面/剖面图，占据下部三分之二的大部分空间。在建筑右侧放置一座高耸的烟囱，延伸至上方区域。保留右侧页边距用于竖排中文标题和小型标注。保留左侧页边距用于编号指南列表和开放时间详情。

主体：一座废弃的工业遗址，呈现为精确的建筑墨线水彩剖面图。展示一座高大的多层工厂框架，带有裸露的钢桁架、脚手架、平台、楼梯、旧砖墙和混凝土墙、大型矩形窗户、拱形底层开口、管道、储罐、小型机械、轨道车类物体，以及用于体现比例的小型人物剪影。在右侧添加一座非常高的圆柱形条纹烟囱，外观风化且呈灰色。建筑应给人一种正在被保护和再生的开放式工业遗迹的感觉，具有透明的剖面楼层和可见的内部结构。

文本内容：在左侧包含 6 个编号指南条目，每个条目带有两位数大编号和双语风格的小标签：01 主入口，02 锅炉房，03 车间，04 机器加工室，05 烟囱 / 水塔，06 观景台。在条目旁添加小的时间范围，例如 09:30 / 13:30, 10:00 / 14:00, 10:40 / 14:40, 11:20 / 15:20, 12:00 / 16:00, 12:30 / 16:30。添加一个开放时间块，写着“OPENING HOURS 09:30 — 17:00”，下方附带较小的中文文本。添加一个带有小号中文文本的地址块。在右侧，添加用于 开工 开放日 工业遗址 的大型竖排中文字符，排列成三列。添加一行小标题“过去 / 现场 / 未来”，并在其下方添加简短的中文标语。在右上角附近添加微小的英文单词：“SITE / MEMORY / FUTURE”。在右下角附近添加微小的堆叠单词：“PRESERVE / REGENERATE / SHARE”。

标注：包含 3 个细红棕色圆形标注图形，分别标记为 02、03 和 05，放置在建筑周围；在右上角附近包含一个单独的圆形日期标记，写着 05 / 18。添加精致的引导线、小刻度标记、微小的标签以及一些年份注释，例如 1958、2012 和 2024。

视觉风格：工业设计海报，建筑蓝图与水墨插画结合，档案博物馆印刷品，磨损的胶印效果，黑色做旧排版，网格化但不对称的瑞士海报构图，微妙的锈迹和墨水渗漏。排版应看起来醒目、有印刷感、略显粗糙，并与纸张物理融合。保持所有元素扁平化且具有海报质感，而非照片级真实感。

约束：仅使用一座主工厂建筑，仅使用一座高烟囱，恰好 6 个指南列表项，恰好 3 个带编号的建筑标注圆圈加 1 个日期圆圈。避免使用鲜艳色彩、光泽效果、现代玻璃建筑、额外 Logo、二维码或水印。
